overview_description.description:
Acquired in 2022.

Most people make decisions about their business relationships using incomplete data, guessing whom to reach out to, or by trusting their instincts.

Fathom interweaves your connections across all your communication platforms to automate your outreach workflow for sales, marketing, fundraising, and more.
